title: Sky-Quality Meter Moonlight Penalty
dataSources: Observing sessions (`astronomy:session`), sky quality (`skyquality:reading`), mount telemetry (`mount:session`), focus metrics (`focus:metric`), observatory roof state (`observatory:roof`), sub-frame results (`astroimage:sub`), and all-sky detections (`allsky:event`).
app: Astronomy telemetry from N.I.N.A., KStars/Ekos, Sky Quality Meters, all-sky cameras, focus routines, roof controllers, and image-rejection logs streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted exports.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=skyquality:reading
| stats avg(sqm) as avg_sqm by moon_phase
| sort moon_phase
description: Shows how sky brightness shifts across moon phases at your observing site.
value: Moonlight effects vary more than many hobbyists expect, and a local penalty chart helps you set realistic session expectations.
implementation: Ingest SQM readings with a moon-phase enrichment from your observatory scheduler or ephemeris service.
visualization: Bar chart of average SQM by moon phase.
grandmaExplanation: It spots how much brighter the sky gets at your location when the moon is in different phases.
